fixtures.description: 20mm cube STL, stock system presets. Baseline pipeline/engine parity.
Same cube as a project 3mf (CLI-authored, arranged). Exercises the 3mf load path on both sides with embedded settings.
CLI slices with --sparse-infill-density 25%; RB measures whether the injected value survives the GUI reopen (BUG-34 sentinel: it currently does not).

Cube translated to (150,80) off the plate center. GUI centers imports (Plater.cpp center_around_origin); CLI keeps file coordinates unless --arrange. Placement-driven gcode divergence is the documented, expected outcome (catalog 1.2.3).
Cube authored in inch units. GUI detects and asks to convert (dialog answered by the sweeper); CLI needs --convert-unit (catalog 1.2.4). Placement will differ (GUI centers).
Project with the cube half below the bed (z=-10). Both pipelines should slice only the visible 10mm; any divergence here is a finding (cf. the --rotate/ensure_on_bed truncation class).

Two objects, one crossing the bed edge (x 238..258 on a 256 bed). Outcome-pair fixture, empirically corrected from catalog 1.5.1: the GUI DISABLES slicing entirely ('laid over the boundary' error, lane G times out by design), the CLI aborts CLI_OBJECTS_PARTLY_INSIDE (-52 = exit 204). Both refuse; the pair documents HOW each refuses.
Outcome-pair fixture: --mtcpp 5 makes the CLI abort on triangle count (12 > 5) while the GUI has no such budget (catalog 1.5.8). Bridge: --mtcpp 0.
Outcome-pair fixture: STEP file. GUI imports it (deflection dialog answered by the sweeper); CLI has no STEP loader and errors (catalog 1.2.2). Not bridgeable.

BUG-32 sentinel: user process preset with inherits and no leaf compatible_printers. GUI accepts the pair; CLI compat gate exits CLI_PROCESS_NOT_COMPATIBLE (-17). When this fixture's lane C turns green, BUG-32 got fixed.
